_comment: The only file a brand decision may live in. Handoff 4.
This copy is the template's own, so it carries no brand and no identity:
slug is 'template', and accountId and appGuid are blank. The guard rejects
any application identifier inside template/, because the template is never
served and receives its identity at build time.
theme maps one to one onto the :root block at the top of style.css. If a
colour appears anywhere below that block, theming silently stops working
for that rule and the guard fails template-purity.
slug is the namespace. Element ids, CSS classes, the localStorage cart key
and custom event names all derive from it, because every demo shares one
origin and two demos open in one browser must not see each other's cart.
displayName is always the Dengage demo name, never the prospect's.
Handoff 1.5: their colours, typography, categories, product names and
photography are used. Their logo and word mark are not.
